entities.summary: James Ugochukwu Nnaji is a Nigerian college basketball player for the Baylor Bears of the Big 12 Conference. He was selected 31st overall in the 2023 NBA draft by the Detroit Pistons, but his rights were traded to the Charlotte Hornets and later the New York Knicks.
